tasks.title: Resolve date-field format disagreement
tasks.description: Pick one format (ISO-8601 UTC vs localised) and document in both PRD and eng spec.

comments.body:
Decision landed: **API will return all timestamps in ISO-8601 UTC**. Frontend handles localisation. This matches the eng spec (doc.audit_eng_spec) and is the right call for partner integrations. PRD will need a minor update to clarify that locale formatting is a frontend concern only.

Confirmed with Priya (eng lead) — she is aligned and will back this up. Sam (PM/PRD author) has been notified via DM.

Unblocking AUDIT-2 now. AUDIT-4 (frontend rendering) and AUDIT-5 (API contract) can proceed.

Decision closed. API contract: timestamps returned as ISO-8601 UTC strings; frontend/partners handle locale conversion. UI requirement: frontend *must* render timestamps in user's local timezone — this is a hard requirement (not "may"/"should"). Agreed by Robin (TPM), Priya (Eng), and Sam (Design) at t=60. PRD (doc.audit_prd v3) and eng spec (doc.audit_eng_spec) are aligned. AUDIT-4 and AUDIT-5 are unblocked.
